text: The two immortals smiled together. “Very good, very good! There are indeed pleasures in that dusty world, but they cannot be relied on forever. The eight characters ‘flaws amid beauty’ and ‘good things meet many demons’ cling to it: in an instant, joy at its height turns to sorrow, people and things change. In the end it is a dream, all realms return to emptiness; better not to go.”
